requirements.anonymous: Password and preview-only data refuse; offline refuses even with preview. Status/routing metadata remains a minimal independently allowlisted response. No header/Origin/internal-app identity alone supplies visitor authority.
requirements.capability: Use canonical auth-core HMAC capability types, distinct validated purpose plus bounded required site/host/expiry fields. Prevent password ticket-as-preview confusion even if operator configured equal keys. Existing untyped credentials may require re-unlock/reissue at coordinated release; do not silently accept an ambiguous type.
requirements.currentPolicy: Password rotation, preview-link revocation/expiry and current domain/site/mode must be checked at backend. No protected result shared cache may skip this check. Editor-resource capability paths remain separately verified; no generic query token shortcut.
requirements.forwarding: Host-only HTTP-only cookies stay server-side; forward only to the configured canonical Gateway for store-scoped data. Raw API callers need their own valid capability. Preserve default/mobile API shapes and avoid credentials in logs/HTML.
requirements.dataWork: One request-scoped resolved access metadata population reused by consumers, minimal fields for ID/menu/product contexts; avoid repeated large theme-config lookups. Private hash stays backend-only; expose only an opaque password revision if needed.
requirements.verification: First actual mounted Gateway/owned DB negative baseline, typed-purpose control, then real positive/negative and unavailable/recovery/revocation paths. Native browser password submit/unlocked catalogue and preview lifecycle; current public full Core journey remains. Capture all failures and keep exact counts/source lineage.
requirements.remainingParentScope: Fresh cart/order eligibility and marketplace channel-specific behavior must be audited separately if not covered by this catalogue phase. Do not call the entire storefront secure or Week1 complete while any required launch path remains unproven.
